name: What preparation do I need to do before you start painting my kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What preparation do I need to do before you start painting my kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before our team begins painting your kitchen, we recommend a few simple preparations. Please clear all items from inside and on top of your cabinets and countertops. Remove any decorative items, small appliances, or personal belongings that are within the work area. While we handle extensive masking and protection, having the space decluttered helps us work more efficiently and ensures the best possible results. If you have any specific concerns about items, please discuss them during our consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before painting, please clear all items from inside and on top of your cabinets and countertops. Removing decorative items and small appliances helps us work efficiently and achieve optimal results.
